events.comment: Ember sits inside the lantern glass, bobbing gently (and shivering with Fear), and always turns to face the player: the hand-layer camera is at the origin, so his yaw is 180 + the angle toward it.
Strength drains at DrainPerSecond. Within a Fireplace's WarmthRadius it recharges instead: 25% of the fire's RechargePerSecond at the edge of the radius, 100% right at the fire.

Ember's Fear (0..MaxFear). Each frame a target is built from what scares him: the nearest Zombie (up to +70, from 1200px away to 200px) and a fading light (up to +30 below 40% Strength). Being near a Fireplace lowers the target. Fear climbs toward the target at FearRisePerSecond and settles at FearCalmPerSecond (twice as fast by a fire). A Zombie first coming within 500px adds an instant +15 spike (re-armed once it is back beyond 800px).
Flame flicker: layered sines + smoothed noise + occasional gutter dips.
